summary: Tested Project Planner (multi-step wizard) and Installation Guide pages. All 15 backend tests pass. All 44 frontend tests pass (25 Project Planner + 12 Installation Guide + 7 Navbar). Mathematical calculations verified: 4m x 2.5m at 5m distance with mixed content = P1.5 pitch, 4.8kW max power, 1.2kW avg power, 'Wall-Mounted or Recessed' install, $25,000-$43,750 budget. PDF download endpoint returns valid application/pdf content.

issues: Console hydration warning: span cannot be child of tbody - minor HTML structure issue but does not affect functionality
